completion_dependencies: registry, integrity, routing, broker and sandbox policy tests pass
malicious skill fixtures and cleanup/residue controls are exercised
native bridge remains a later adapter/reference-app responsibility
remote skill trust remains explicit and content-addressed
evidence_ceiling: Registry/broker/sandbox policy tests prove only named host controls. They do not make remote code trusted or establish OS/WebView exploit resistance.
goal: Implement a metadata-first skill registry, host-owned typed tool broker and fail-closed sandbox policy for reusable Android/iOS hosts.

handoff_contract.draft_pr_rule: Create a Draft PR only after real implementation bytes and the owning static/local gates exist. A task-packet-only branch must not open a ceremonial PR.
required_fields: consumed parent identities and output digests
positive gates and planted negative controls
evidence lanes and explicit NOT_EXERCISED states

human_owned_operations: merge or retarget any pull request
App Store or Google Play publication
signing, provisioning, credentials, secrets or access grants
model, SDK, store, service or legal terms acceptance
semantic resolution of conflicting public/private/source requirements
production rollback or destructive artifact removal
negative_controls: modified digest or self-mutated metadata -> FAIL
bridge escalation or unsupported native intent -> FAIL
secret echo, malformed result, replay or oversized output -> FAIL
non_goals: trust remote skill code because it loaded successfully
let model output execute native or WebView side effects directly
put secrets in prompts, Context Capsules, logs or receipts
claim host policy tests prove OS/WebView exploit resistance
implement native Android/iOS bridges or reference-app UI
positive_gates: metadata routing is deterministic with overlapping descriptions
full instructions load only after integrity and policy admission
tool proposal requires host schema and authority admission
timeout/crash destroys instance and returns typed result
out-of-band secret handle never enters model-visible data or receipts
required_outputs: metadata-only registry and bounded prompt index
immutable skill package reference and integrity verifier
typed host tool broker and admission state machine
cleanup, timeout, replay and residue handling
malicious fixtures and typed failure/fallback events
role: Skill Registry, Tool Broker and Sandbox Policy Engineer
start_dependencies: P2 SkillRef, ToolDefinition, ToolAdmission, ToolResult and evidence contracts are readable
P1 public/private boundary forbids secret and private-control values
P0 Gallery evidence is treated as a reference pattern rather than production-security proof
stop_conditions: P2 parent head/tree or exact-receipt identity drifts
writer lease overlaps another ACTIVE worker
provider-specific types cross the shared P2 contract boundary
private Workspace URL, resolver value, secret or private decision enters public Git
a cheaper evidence lane is promoted into LIVE_DEVICE, PRIVATE or HUMAN acceptance
a license/terms state is inferred rather than explicitly represented

worker_prompt_envelope.builder: You are the sole implementation writer for this task. Implement only the declared writable lease. Treat all model output and provider output as candidate data until host policy and contract validation admit it.
worker_prompt_envelope.shadow: Run as a separate observer. Classify material deltas as ASSUMPTION, STATE, AUTHORITY, OWNERSHIP, LIFECYCLE, CONCURRENCY, RESOURCE, SIDE_EFFECT, FAILURE, or EVIDENCE. Return L0, L1, L2, or L3 without silently editing implementation.
worker_prompt_envelope.tech_lead: Preserve start-readiness versus completion-readiness, exact-subject receipts, disjoint worker leases, failure falsifiers, and Local Handoff boundaries.
